user.title: Set up remotes
user.description: Enter the names of your remotes (device_name from ESPHome, comma separated). Keep the key as is.

fertig.title: Almost done – add the key to ESPHome
fertig.description:
Copy this line into the ESPHome **Secrets** (ESPHome add-on → top right "Secrets") and flash the remote once more:

`esphomeremote_konfig_key: "{key}"`

Then open **"Remote"** in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. Add more remotes via "Configure".

init.title: Remotes
init.description: Remote names (device_name, comma separated). Key for the ESPHome secrets: `{key}`

an_remotes.name: To all remotes
an_remotes.description: Calls an ESPHome service on all connected remotes (esphome.<remote>_<service>).

dienst.name: Service
dienst.description: Part after the device name, e.g. refresh_cover, doorbell_image, remote_show_keyboard

regeln.name: Adjust step by step
regeln.description: For keys and follow modes of the remote: light brighter/darker, colour temperature, fan speed, toggle oscillation.

schritt.name: Step
schritt.description: Brightness in %, colour temperature in Kelvin, fan in steps (negative = down/warmer)

remote_log.name: Remote log via the dock
remote_log.description: Called by the dock when a remote without its own HA connection radios its log (only with debug log on). Errors and warnings go to the HA log, all lines to the configurator.

wlan_kommt.name: Remote turns on its Wi-Fi
wlan_kommt.description: Called by the dock when a remote is about to turn on its Wi-Fi (voice to HA, no dock). HA then connects as soon as it is reachable.

remote_status.name: Remote values via the dock
remote_status.description: Called by the dock when a remote without its own HA connection radios its values (battery, charging cable, activity, deep sleep status, key configuration). Writes them to the remote's entities while it isn't connected itself.

timer_verlaengern.name: Extend timer
timer_verlaengern.description: Restarts the last finished timer (from the remotes' selection) with this duration – for the “+5 min” button in the timer popup.

timer_neu_starten.name: Restart timer
timer_neu_starten.description: Restarts the last finished timer with its previous duration (“Again” button in the timer popup).

blaster_senden.name: Send via another IR/RF transmitter
blaster_senden.description: Sends a raw code via an IR transmitter of another integration (infrared entity) or a Broadlink (IR or 433 MHz) – like a dock. The remotes call this for transmitters chosen instead of a dock in the configurator.

code.name: Code
code.description: Times in microseconds, + on / - off, comma-separated

licht.name: Control lights (light widget)
licht.description: Operation of the remote's light widget: switches, dims, sets colour temperature or colour per light only as far as it supports, or activates a scene.

aktion.name: Action
aktion.description: an, aus, toggle, hell, kelvin, farbe or szene

wert.name: Value
wert.description: hell: percent, kelvin: e.g. 2700, farbe: hue,saturation (e.g. 30,100), szene: scene.xyz

kamera_tv.name: Camera on the TV
kamera_tv.description: Shows a camera as picture-in-picture on the TV (Configurator > Features), or hides it.

kamera_groesse.name: Camera size on the TV
kamera_groesse.description: Klein, Mittel, Groß, Fast Vollbild (small, medium, large, almost full screen) or "naechste" (cycle). A running camera takes the new size immediately.

kamera_position.name: Camera corner on the TV
kamera_position.description: Corner of the camera (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, center) or "naechste" (clockwise). A running camera moves immediately.

neustart.name: Restart device (ADB)
neustart.description: Restarts an Android device that is entered in the configurator under Features.

geraet.name: Device
geraet.description: Name as in the configurator (e.g. Streamer)
